First check the selected language in the menu.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Give the first language-setting check.
Controleer is the imperative stem with the colleague understood. Eerst orders the check before later actions; de gekozen taal is what to inspect.
QS=Welke printer|V=staat|T=op dit moment|C=als standaard ingesteld?
Which printer is currently set as the default?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask which printer is the current default.
Welke printer is the singular question subject of staat. Als standaard ingesteld describes its current default setting, not a printer standing physically somewhere.
Can you read the version number at the bottom of the screen?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Request the visible version number.
Kun takes bare infinitive lezen. Het versienummer is the object to read and onderaan het scherm locates it.
Leave the current settings unchanged for now.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask the colleague to preserve the settings during inspection.
Laat is an imperative with de huidige instellingen as object. Ongewijzigd names the state to preserve; voorlopig means for now.
The selected time zone does not match our location.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Point out the mismatch in the time-zone setting.
Overeenkomen splits as komt ... overeen. Met onze locatie gives the comparison target; niet denies a match.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Check whether automatic synchronisation is enabled.
Is begins a yes/no question about the enabled state. Ingeschakeld is the participle of separable inschakelen, not another finite verb.
I write down the original value.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Say you record the value before changing anything.
Opschrijven splits as schrijf ... op. De oorspronkelijke waarde is the original value being recorded, before a later change in this scenario.
Before we change anything, we take a screenshot.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Describe the record made before a settings change.
Voordat introduces the before-clause ending in wijzigen. Main maken we follows it; the screenshot precedes any change.
Where do I find the notification settings?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask where notification settings are located.
Waar asks location, followed by vind ik. Voor meldingen specifies notification settings, not a time deadline.
This check does not change your password.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Reassure a formally addressed user about the check's scope.
Verandert agrees with deze controle and takes uw wachtwoord as object. Niet denies changing it in this particular check, not in every possible procedure.
Start with a new blank document.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Give the starting condition for the test.
Begin is an imperative. Met een nieuw leeg document gives the starting material; nieuw and leeg have no -e after een with singular het document.
Can you repeat the same action with a test file?
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask for repetition using test data.
Kun takes bare infinitive herhalen. Dezelfde handeling is the repeated action, and met een testbestand specifies test input.
I follow exactly the steps in your description.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Tell a formally addressed user you follow their steps.
Volg is the ik-form of volgen. Precies specifies following the stated steps exactly; uw beschrijving is the formally addressed user's description.
G=Zodra ik op bewaren klik,|V=verschijnt|S=de foutcode.
As soon as I click save, the error code appears.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Link the error's appearance to the save click.
Zodra introduces the trigger and ends in klik. Bewaren is the name of the Save control after op; main verschijnt de foutcode follows the trigger clause.
The test has not yielded a clear result yet.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Report that the result remains inconclusive.
Opleveren splits as levert ... op. Nog geen duidelijk resultaat reports an inconclusive state so far, without implying no information of any kind was collected.
Which step comes immediately before the error message?
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask for the action immediately preceding the message.
Welke stap is the singular question subject of komt. Vlak voor asks for the immediately preceding step, not a proven cause.
We have reproduced the error on a second device.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Report a successful reproduction on another device.
Hebben herhaald is perfect, with no ge- after her-. Op een tweede toestel locates this successful reproduction, not a completed repair.
I want to test the behaviour without an attachment first.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. State the next test condition.
Wil takes bare infinitive testen. Eerst orders this test and zonder bijlage sets the attachment-free condition; this is an intention, not a result.
Do not use real customer data for this test.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Specify test-data limits.
Gebruik is an imperative. Geen echte klantgegevens excludes real customer data specifically for this test.
S=We|V=onderzoeken|G=of de fout ook bij een nieuwe sessie optreedt.
We investigate whether the error also occurs in a new session.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Describe a new-session reproduction check.
Of introduces whether and ends in joined optreedt. Ook bij een nieuwe sessie asks about another condition, without claiming reproduction succeeded there.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Ask a formally addressed user to save their work.
Opslaan splits as sla ... op in this imperative. Uw open documenten are what to save; eerst puts saving before the next step.
May I close the application after your confirmation?
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Request permission to close the application.
Mag requests permission and takes bare infinitive sluiten. Na uw bevestiging makes the user's confirmation a prerequisite to closing the application.
IM=Herstart|O=alleen het programma,|NEG=niet de hele computer.
Restart only the program, not the whole computer.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Limit the restart to the program.
Herstart is the imperative stem. Alleen het programma limits the restart to that program; niet de hele computer excludes a full-device restart.
G=Als er niet-opgeslagen werk is,|V=wachten|S=we|T=nog even.
If there is unsaved work, we will wait a little longer.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Explain the condition for postponing the action.
Als introduces the condition and ends in is. Main wachten we follows it; nog even means a little longer while unsaved work remains.
I do not delete any files during this check.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. State that files are not deleted during the check.
Verwijder is the ik-form. Geen bestanden denies deleting any files during this specific check, not all file deletion in every workflow.
Do not disconnect the cable yet.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Ask the user to leave the cable connected.
Loskoppelen splits as koppel ... los. Nog niet means not yet, so the cable must remain connected for now.
We try the least disruptive step first.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Explain the order of diagnostic actions.
Proberen is plural present with we. Eerst sets the order and de minst ingrijpende stap means the least disruptive step, without guaranteeing success.
Eerst proberen we de minst ingrijpende stap.
We try the least disruptive step first.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
MOD=Kun|S=je|O=de melding|I=sluiten|PP=zonder het document te sluiten?
Can you dismiss the message without closing the document?
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Ask about dismissing only the message.
Kun takes infinitive sluiten before the following zonder-phrase. Zonder het document te sluiten excludes closing the document; the message alone is to be dismissed.
IM=Stop|O=de test|G=als er een onverwachte waarschuwing verschijnt.
Stop the test if an unexpected warning appears.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Give a clear condition for stopping the test.
Stop is an imperative. Als introduces the stopping condition and ends in verschijnt with singular een onverwachte waarschuwing.
S=Ik|V=leg|PART=uit|G=welke gegevens bij deze stap behouden blijven.
I explain which data is retained in this step.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Describe explaining data retention before proceeding.
Uitleggen splits as leg ... uit. Welke gegevens is the embedded plural subject; behouden blijven means remain retained in this step.
On my device, opening takes three seconds.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Give your measured opening time.
Op mijn toestel is fronted before duurt het openen. Het openen is a nominalised infinitive and singular subject; drie seconden measures its duration.
Het openen duurt op mijn toestel drie seconden.
On my device, opening takes three seconds.

The same actor, action, time and certainty are retained. This wording changes the first constituent or the position of the time phrase. In a Dutch main clause the finite verb stays second in constituents, with the subject after it when another constituent is fronted.
The second attempt is faster than the first.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Compare the first and second attempts.
Sneller is comparative followed by dan de eerste, with poging understood. The second attempt is compared with the first, without proving why it is faster.
Can you put both error codes side by side?
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Request a side-by-side comparison.
Kun takes bare infinitive zetten. Beide foutcodes are the objects and naast elkaar gives the side-by-side arrangement for comparison.
The version numbers are not identical.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Report different version numbers.
Zijn agrees with plural de versienummers. Niet gelijk says the numbers differ, without identifying which version is correct.
Both users have the same permissions.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. State that permissions match for both users.
Beide gebruikers is plural with hebben. Dezelfde rechten means matched permissions, not necessarily identical devices or results.
S=Ik|V=vergelijk|O=de resultaten|G=terwijl jij de tijden noteert.
I compare the results while you note the times.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Divide comparison and timing between you and your colleague.
Terwijl introduces simultaneous work and ends in noteert. Ik compares results while jij records times; the two people have distinct tasks.
What difference do you see between the two windows?
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Ask for an observed window difference.
Welk verschil is the question object, and je is the subject after zie. Tussen de twee vensters gives the comparison target.
We have run the same test on both networks.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Report a completed comparison under matched test conditions.
Hebben uitgevoerd is perfect of separable uitvoeren. Dezelfde test names the matched test used on both networks; this does not assert identical results.
With the same account, the other laptop does work.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Contrast devices while keeping the account the same.
Met hetzelfde account is fronted before werkt de andere laptop. Wel contrasts successful operation on that other device despite using the same account.
De andere laptop werkt met hetzelfde account wel.
With the same account, the other laptop does work.

I do not yet know why the results differ.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Separate an observed difference from its explanation.
Waarom introduces an embedded why-question with final verschillen and plural de resultaten. Nog niet limits current knowledge, not the existence of a difference.
Perhaps the problem is with the connection.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Suggest a connection hypothesis without certainty.
Misschien signals a hypothesis and is fronted before ligt het probleem. Liggen aan names a possible cause here, rather than physical posture.
The timing does not prove a connection.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Explain that timing alone is not proof.
Bewijst agrees with de timing. Niet denies that timing proves a connection, without asserting there is definitely no connection.
S=We|V=onderzoeken|G=of de cache een rol speelt.
We investigate whether the cache plays a role.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Describe a cache hypothesis under investigation.
Of introduces whether and ends in speelt. Een rol spelen means play a role; the cache is under investigation, not already established as the cause.
I have not established a cause yet.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. State that the cause remains unconfirmed.
Heb vastgesteld is perfect of separable vaststellen. Nog geen oorzaak denies an established cause so far, rather than the existence of any cause.
We cannot rule out a permissions problem yet.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Keep a permissions issue among possible causes.
Kunnen takes joined infinitive uitsluiten. Nog niet means not yet; the permissions issue remains a possibility rather than a confirmed diagnosis.
G=Omdat slechts één account getroffen is,|V=bekijken|S=we|O=de rechten.
Because only one account is affected, we look at the permissions.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Explain why permissions are the next check.
Omdat supplies the reason and ends in is. Main bekijken we follows it; the limited affected scope motivates a permissions check without proving its result.
S=Deze test|V=helpt|TE=om het netwerk als oorzaak uit te sluiten.
This test helps to rule out the network as the cause.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Explain the diagnostic purpose of the test.
Helpt takes om ... uit te sluiten for the action assisted. Uitsluiten is separable with te between uit and sluiten; the test helps exclusion rather than guaranteeing a complete diagnosis.
The latest change is not necessarily the cause.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Avoid assuming the most recent change caused the fault.
De oorzaak is a complement after is. Niet noodzakelijk means not necessarily; the latest change could be the cause but its recency alone does not prove it.
I do not want to guess while the data is missing.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Explain why you are withholding a diagnosis.
Wil takes bare infinitive gissen. Zolang introduces the continuing condition and ends in plural ontbreken with de gegevens.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Ask for evidence supporting the hypothesis.
Welke aanwijzingen is the plural question subject of ondersteunen. Deze verklaring is the object whose supporting evidence is being requested.
I am going to look at the log files now.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Announce your next diagnostic action.
Ga is finite and bekijken is a bare infinitive announcing the next action. Nu sets its immediate timing; the files have not already been analysed.
Nu ga ik de logbestanden bekijken.
I am going to look at the log files now.

We need to know the exact error code first.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. State the prerequisite for the next step.
Moeten is plural with we and takes infinitive weten. Eerst makes the exact error code a prerequisite for the next action.
My colleague is testing the connection.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Report your colleague's ongoing connection test.
Is aan het testen describes an ongoing activity. De verbinding is the object being tested; testen is infinitive, not a completed participle.
I will let you know what the check yields.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Promise a report of findings rather than a fix.
Laat je weten means notify you, with je as recipient. Wat introduces the reported findings and the clause ends in oplevert; the promise is information, not a fix.
Keep the error message for the next check.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Ask the user to preserve diagnostic evidence.
Bewaar is an imperative. Voor de volgende controle gives purpose; keep the error message as evidence for that later check.
After that, we are going to discuss the results.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Announce discussion after the check.
Daarna is fronted before gaan we. Bespreken is the bare infinitive for the intended discussion after the diagnostic check.
We gaan daarna de resultaten bespreken.
After that, we are going to discuss the results.

S=Een geslaagde test|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat elke situatie getest is.
A successful test does not mean every situation has been tested.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Limit the conclusion from a successful test.
Niet denies an inference from one success. In the dat-clause, elke situatie is singular with tested-result getest is; one passed test does not cover all situations.
Which step has the most value now?
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Ask which diagnostic step is most useful next.
Welke stap is the singular question subject of heeft. De meeste waarde asks which step is most useful now, not which has already succeeded.
S=Ik|V=ben|C=bezig|PP=met het onderzoek naar de vertraging.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Describe your ongoing investigation.
Ben bezig met describes ongoing work. Het onderzoek is a noun after met and naar de vertraging identifies its topic; onderzoeken is not the written form used in this model.
G=Als deze test niets oplevert,|V=vragen|S=we|O=extra hulp.
If this test yields nothing, we will ask for extra help.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Explain the fallback if testing is inconclusive.
The als-clause ends in oplevert. Niets is its object, meaning no useful result here; main vragen we follows with extra hulp as the fallback request.
